content: A single tree that falls in the forest makes a deafening crash, but a thousand trees growing in silence make no sound at all.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: Destruction, scandal, and violence are violent, abrupt, and loud; they dominate headlines and terrify the mind. But all across the vast continent, billions of roots are silently drinking water, millions of mothers are quietly singing to babies, and goodness is quietly growing. Trust the silent forest.
practicalInsight: Turn off sensationalist news today. Reconnect with the quiet, invisible acts of love quietly holding the world together.
reflectionPrompt: Are you letting the loud crash of a single falling tree blind you to the vast, silent forest growing all around you?
